facts.statement: The study created an online tool to visualize and compare single-cell data from the basal ganglia.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: Researchers used four specific technologies to generate the multi-omics datasets: 10X Multiome, single-nucleus methylome sequencing, snm3C-seq, and Paired-Tag.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: The platform allows comparison of data from four species: humans, macaques, marmosets, and mice.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: Sample analyses on the platform show how gene regulation varies by cell type, which elements are shared or unique across species, and how epigenomic changes link to gene transcription.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: The authors state this resource serves as a foundation for future research into brain function and disease mechanisms.
facts.subject: computational
